name: Amamiya
source:
An acquaintance of the protagonist.
After watching an old video he proclaims himself a 'detective'.
A guy who can't read the mood and doesn't listen to people, but he considers himself the protagonist's helper.
[spoiler]a sub capturable character with his own ending[/spoiler]
